# 2 Baruch Chapter 82 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** "So do not mourn over what has happened to you. The time of completion is near, and the fullness of the ages is about to arrive."

**2** "Do not be distressed over the troubles that have come on Israel. Israel's rescue is drawing near, and the end of the suffering is at hand."

**3** "Do not be afraid — the Mighty One will deliver you. Do not fear your enemies — the hour of your redemption is approaching."

**4** "The appointed time is near; the day of judgment is at hand; and the end of the ages will come."

**5** "All evil will be uprooted and all wickedness swept away, while the covenant of the Mighty One will stand forever."

**6** "Those found worthy of the kingdom will inherit it; those found righteous will be lifted up; those found wicked will be condemned."

**7** "Those who have known the law will be vindicated; those who have not known it will get what they deserve."

**8** "Now remember your dead ancestors. Hold tightly to the covenant they made with the Mighty One. Keep the deeds of your fathers in mind."

**9** "The name of your ancestors will live on forever. God will not forget the name of Israel, and the descendants of Jacob will not be cut off."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
